## bluefin-cli wallpaper

Set the desktop wallpaper (macOS, GNOME)

### Synopsis

Set the desktop wallpaper natively — macOS (via the 'wallpaper' brew
formula or AppleScript) and GNOME (via gsettings). With no argument, shows
the current wallpaper.

```
bluefin-cli wallpaper [image] [flags]
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help   help for wallpaper
```
